scope: W02 fixed-grid constant-density multi-cohort transport, formation ages and prescribed transfer events
status: WORKING NON-CANON; synthetic mathematical tests, not geological acceptance
physical_law: dH_k/dt + d(u H_k)/dx = 0 between explicit events; total H=sum_k H_k
conventions: Each cohort has a stable ID, material class, origin and optional known formation time.
Unknown formation time is null, not zero; fractions in empty columns need the occupancy mask.
No separately evolved total is rescaled to match the cohorts.
Constant face forcing and incoming composition during an interval; split at changes/events.
Events are given amounts at the exact state time, not generated magmatic/subduction rates.
Parent-state checks prevent applying the same event to its successor.
A self-contained snapshot preserves cohorts with zero remaining inventory.
No lower-order or lower-precision fallback to improve runtime.
